deadline.value: No closing date is given on the Biological Sciences PhD page.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject test is mentioned on the Biological Sciences PhD page.

supervisor.value: Contacting a supervisor before applying is advised, not required.
supervisor.quote: Before applying we recommend securing a supervisor in order to apply for your research project.

funding.value: Students are selected for the department's studentships, or must have other support, so funding is not guaranteed.
funding.quote: All members of academic staff can accept suitably qualified PhD students who we select for our studentships, or who have alternative means of support.

entry_route.value: A first or upper second class honours degree or an MSc in a biological subject is required.
entry_route.quote: Applicants should have, or expect to be awarded, a First or Upper Second Class Honours Degree or MSc in an appropriate biological discipline.

notes: Lab-based projects attract bench fees of up to GBP 5,000 a year on top of tuition, negotiated per project.
